Refund policy

Returns Policy 

For most products bought online, you have the legal right under the Consumer Contracts Regulations 2013 to change your mind within the 14 day Cooling-Off period and receive a refund.

As our collagen products are an ingestible supplement, the right to change your mind does not apply, and we cannot accept returns due to quality control, and health & safety. We take great care in producing our collagen and cannot re-stock food products once they have left our control.

Subject to these terms and conditions, we are, of course, able to accept returns if we have processed your order in error – or if we have failed to action your request (provided it was before Midnight, the day before your upcoming order date). If you’re concerned that your product is damaged, in this instance, please get in touch via the contact page and we can assist you with the matter and issue a refund where
